desc.p: Returns the draft logs (field notes) of the user, e.g. those uploaded with services/draftlogs/upload_fieldnotes or on the website. Use the draft_id values to delete drafts with services/draftlogs/delete.
This method is only available on installations that support draft logs. Check the has_draft_logs field in services/apisrv/installation before calling it.

opt.name: cache_code
opt.p: If given, only the drafts for this geocache are returned.

returns.p: A list of dictionaries, ordered by date, each with the following keys:

ul.li: draft_id - ID of the draft log (a string),
type - Found it, Didn't find it or Comment,
needs_maintenance2 - true if the draft reports that the geocache needs maintenance (a comment with "needs maintenance" set), otherwise false,
date - date and time of the draft, in ISO 8601 format,
comment - text of the draft, in HTML.
